mapper.select: SELECT c.Con_Id, c.Con_Name, COALESCE(c.Con_Money_Total, 0) AS conMoneyTotal, COALESCE(c.Con_Money_Tentative, 0) AS conMoneyTentative, COALESCE(e.approvedChangeAmount, 0) AS approvedChangeAmount, COALESCE(e.pendingChangeAmount, 0) AS pendingChangeAmount FROM Con_Contract c LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ec.Con_Id, SUM(CASE WHEN ec.Ec_State = 7 THEN COALESCE(ec.party_a_amount, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS approvedChangeAmount, SUM(CASE WHEN ec.Ec_State NOT IN (7, 3, 0) THEN COALESCE(ec.party_a_amount, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS pendingChangeAmount FROM Con_EC ec INNER JOIN Con_Contract scope_con ON scope_con.Con_Id = ec.Con_Id WHERE scope_con.Con_Project_Id = #{pId} AND scope_con.Con_Approval_State = 7 GROUP BY ec.Con_Id ) e ON e.Con_Id = c.Con_Id WHERE c.Con_Project_Id = #{pId} AND c.Con_Approval_State = 7 ORDER BY c.Con_Code, c.Con_Id

SELECT Ec_Id, change_name AS changeName, party_b_amount AS partyBAmount, party_a_amount AS partyAAmount, Ec_State_Time, Ec_Remark, Ec_State FROM Con_EC WHERE Con_Id = #{conId}
AND Ec_State = 7
AND Ec_State NOT IN (7, 3, 0)
ORDER BY CASE WHEN Ec_State_Time IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, Ec_State_Time DESC, CASE WHEN Ec_Create_Time IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, Ec_Create_Time DESC, Ec_Id DESC
